[CAMPUS & PROFESSION]{.eyebrow}

# Service

Contributions to campus governance, student learning, and the broader research community.

[Penn State Great Valley](#campus-service) &middot; [Service to the profession](#professional-service)
:::

::: {#campus-service .service-section}
## Service to Penn State Great Valley

### Faculty Senate leadership

- **Chair**, Fall 2024–present.
- **Secretary**, Fall 2020–Fall 2024 and Fall 2017–Summer 2018.
- **Vice-chair**, Fall 2018–Summer 2020.

### Committees and campus governance

- **Student Affairs Committee:** Chair, Fall 2022–Fall 2024 and Fall 2016–Spring 2020; member, Fall 2020–Fall 2022 and Fall 2013–Summer 2016.
- **Diversity Action Council:** Member, Fall 2013–Fall 2014.
- **Information Science Program Assessment Committee:** Member, Fall 2016–present.
- **Data Analytics Program Assessment Committee:** Member, Fall 2017–present.
- **Academic Integrity and Research:** Member, Fall 2016–Fall 2020.
- **Engineering Council:** Member, 2013–present.

### Student research and professional development

- **Student Poster Presentations:** Organized the first four events: April 4–7, 2017; February 13–16, 2018; February 12–14, 2019; and February 13–15, 2020.
- **Apache Spark training:** Organized a two-day workshop on “Big Data Technologies Training: Apache Spark” for Penn State Great Valley students, March 13–14, 2019.
- **United Airlines internships:** Collaborated with United Airlines to organize internships for three Penn State Great Valley students each semester. Students worked on 14-week predictive analytics projects addressing employee injuries and aircraft damage.
- **MPS Data Analytics capstone partnerships:** Organized 14-week student projects with GlaxoSmithKline (GSK), Datakwip Holdings Inc., United Way Chester County, and AQUA, connecting students with practical applications of big data and predictive analytics.
:::

::: {#professional-service .service-section}
## Service to the profession

### Editorial service

Member of the editorial board of the *International Journal of Data Mining, Modelling and Management*.

### Peer review

Reviewer for papers submitted to:

- *International Journal of Data Mining, Modelling and Management*
- *International Journal of Computational Biology and Drug Design*
- *Information Sciences*
- *Innovations in Systems and Software Engineering*
- *Oncoscience*
- *Human-centric Computing and Information Sciences*
- *BMC Bioinformatics*
- *IEEE Systems Journal*
- *Information and Management*
- *Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering*
- *Heliyon*
- *Mathematical Biosciences and Engineering*
- *Journal of Big Data: Theory and Practice*
- *Arabian Journal for Science and Engineering*

### Conference leadership

- **Complex Adaptive Systems 2021 (CAS 2021):** Conference general chair.
- **Complex Adaptive Systems 2019 (CAS 2019):** Awards committee chair and organizing committee member.

### Talks and industry training

- **EdTech Engage 2017**, University Park, Pennsylvania, October 5–6, 2017: Lightning talk on “Predictive Modeling and Visualization of Emotions in Twitter Feeds.”
- **Philadelphia Big Data Symposium 2017**, University of Pennsylvania, October 13, 2017: Presented “Predictive Modeling and Visualization of Emotions in Twitter Feeds.”
- **Guidewire Software Inc.:** Organized two three-day workshops on “Big Data Technologies Training: Apache Spark.”
:::
